description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DatabaseBackupService' within the 'OrangeHRM\FunctionalTesting\Service' namespace. The class manages database savepoints for testing purposes, including creating, restoring, and deleting savepoints, with data stored and retrieved from a cache, and interacts with the database schema. It uses traits for logging, caching, and ORM helpers, and leverages Doctrine DBAL for database interactions.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Manages database savepoints for testing environments, providing methods to create, restore, and delete savepoints using database queries and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the Doctrine DBAL connection object from the entity manager.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager to interact with database schema, such as listing tables.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Obtains the cache adapter used for storing savepoint data, specifically the 'functional-testing' cache.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a savepoint based on its name.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a specific cache key for a savepoint and table combination.

methods.name: createSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a savepoint with the specified name, storing current table data into the cache.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial savepoint after clearing all prior savepoints, representing the baseline database state.

methods.name: _createSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to capture current table data and store it as a savepoint in cache.

methods.name: restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database state to a named savepoint by re-inserting data from cache.

methods.name: restoreToInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Restores the database to the initial savepoint state.

methods.name: _restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that resets tables to saved data by deleting current data and reinserting cached data.

methods.name: deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Deletes a specific savepoint from cache by name.

methods.name: deleteSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple savepoints; if no names provided, deletes all savepoints.

methods.name: _deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to clear cache entries for a specific savepoint prefix.

methods.name: deleteAllSavepoints
methods.description: Clears all stored savepoints and initial states from cache.
